context: Sho and Hina watch their favorite TV program.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、好きな番組、始まった。
lines.style: Soft, quiet announcement—not asking for attention, just sharing. Small genuine excitement threading through. Light pace, almost conversational. The warmth of including her in something he's noticed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate delight. Open-vowel attack on the exclamation. Pure child joy without performance—unselfconscious and genuine. Quick pace, lifted energy at the line end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お絵かき、コーナー、楽しみ。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to the drawing part.
lines.style: Quiet anticipation. Soft voice, almost thinking aloud. The small tremor of genuine looking-forward-to-something. Measured pace. Trailing slightly on the end, like he can already picture it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、歌の、コーナー、好き。
lines.en: I like the song part the best.
lines.style: Bright declaration of preference. Clear, unguarded. The warmth of sharing what you like with someone you want to like it too. Open, engaged delivery. Slight lift on the preference.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Watching together like this is fun.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Small, genuine observation—not performing sentiment, just noticing it. Soft throughout. The tenderness of something simple made better by her being there. Gentle trailing-off.
